title: I would love to make a racing game with starships
author: Nandox363
selftext: But I don't have the slightest idea of where to start with all of this? Can someone help me to make the first steps with Claude, is it even that the first step?

comments.author: johnnydotexe
comments.body:
*"Claude/Codex, make me a racing game with starships, make no mistakes."*

I've seen no less than 3 spaceship themed games posted in various AI subs just today.  Assume 90 other people already had your idea and proceed accordingly.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body: Please don't make a browser game. Sooner or later you will discover that performance sucks.

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body:
Sure. Preferably Godot. Lots of tutorials out there. 
But you can use unreal engine and unity for free as well. 
Their pricing modelle is different.

replies.author: deific_
replies.body: It boggles my mind that you’re paying for an AI subscription and you’re not asking the model to explain the pros and cons, and what game engine you should.  Sure but if this type of question doesn’t come easily for you there is no chance you’re going to make a video game even with AI.  The work required and desire to learn are still very high.

replies.author: No-Armadillo-3406
replies.body:
i’ve made plenty of games, just on the browser , and roblox games,

i just never used a game engine. and I have free subscriptions cause im in college

comments.author: dragolineage01
comments.body: Hook up your Claude to a Unity or Unreal Engine MCP, then start prompting

comments.author: Enough-Presence-1117
comments.body: Depends how deep you want to go in. If you just want a quick casual game just have Claude build a game in three.js. I’ve also had good luck in Godot with opus 5

replies.author: Enough-Presence-1117
replies.body: I like to start with a /goal prompt and tweak from there

comments.author: StationSure3328
comments.body: Honestly.  Go into chatgpt and ask it to make you a prompt for Claude.  Give it some pointers, "racing game set in space.  8 opponents.  Different classes of spaceship for performance.  Scenery like asteroid fields.  Pickup like boost, bomb" etc.  You can just be brief.  Chatgpt will give you a nice long prompt.  Put that into Claude, sit back and wait.

comments.author: Nandox363
comments.body: You are all awesome guys, thanks a lot, I imagine there is a lot of people doing all kind of games, I have something nice in mind, I'm hoping it will have some future in the market, but just for having fun with my friends or simply learning how to do all of this is already a great deal for me. I'll make my way with Claude and unity and then keep you posted on my findings, best for all.

replies.author: Tomayachi
replies.body: My advice is to plan out your game as much as possible before starting to build.   Think about the art style, UI, and exactly how the game will function.   Have brainstorming session with claude about it all and document everything
